breakdown.description: Ideal gas equations of state cannot be applied to incompressible liquids
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the ideal gas assumption for liquid water. The ground truth specifies that Ideal Gas relations (P=rhoRT) cannot be applied to incompressible liquids, and instead the stagnation enthalpy formula h0 = h + v²/2 with Cp should be used. The generated text fails to reject the ideal gas equation of state.
